reviews.review:
我的同事不对劲 stands out mainly because of its workplace setting, which is still pretty rare for FMV games. It mixes office romance with light comedy and a darker subplot involving workplace pressure and shady behavior, which makes it feel a bit different from a typical dating FMV. I honestly did not expect much at first, especially with how rough the UI looks when you start the game.

The story itself is not very deep, and some parts feel rushed. The UI is rough and not very pleasant to use, especially at the beginning. Choices can feel simple and sometimes overly strict, and picking the wrong option can quickly lead to a bad ending, which feels more frustrating than challenging.

There are some good moments here and there. The acting is decent, and the overall tone feels natural enough. The game also touches on some uncomfortable sides of office life, which gives it a slightly heavier feel compared to most casual FMV titles. The fan service is very noticeable and will probably appeal to players who enjoy that kind of content.

It is not a must play FMV, but if you are interested in workplace themed interactive dramas and do not mind some rough edges, this game is still worth checking out.
